notice_text: Request for Bids Small Works (Two-Envelope Bidding Process) Employer: Ministry of Public Works, Infrastructure and Utilities Project: Urban Resilience Project Contract title: MAJURO RESILIENT PUBLIC SPACE IMPROVEMENT Phase 1: Lot 1(Alele museum site) and Lot 2 (Katoj park site) Country: Marshall Islands Grant No.: Grant No.: E6610-MH RFB No.: MH-MWIU-571264-CW-RFB Issued on: October 22, 2026 1. The Ministry of Public Works, Infrastructure and Utilities (MPWIU), Republic of the Marshall Islands, represented by the Project Implementation Unit (PIU) (Employer), has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Urban Resilience Project – Component 3, and intends to apply part of the proceeds toward payments under the contracts for the Majuro Resilient Public Space Improvement. 2. The Ministry of Public Works, Infrastructure and Utilities (MPWIU) now invites sealed Bids from eligible Bidders for the development of Alele Museum Site and Katoj Park Site, Majuro Atoll, divided into two (2) Lots:         Lot 1 (Alele Museum Site) – Phase 1,         Lot 2 (Katoj Park Site) – Phase 1, to enhance public open space, recreational space, cultural heritage value, and climate resilience at Majuro's key civic, cultural, and recreational sites. Bidders may bid for one or both Lots, as further defined in this Bidding Document. No discount for the award of a combination of Lots shall apply; each Lot's Bid Price shall be evaluated individually. Full details of the scope for each Lot are set out in Section II (Bid Data Sheet) and Section VII (Works' Requirements) of this Bidding Document. As a summary, the estimated construction period for Lot 1 is 12 months and Lot 2 is 18 months, with a Defects Liability Period of 12 months for each Lot. 3. Bidding will be conducted through international competitive procurement using Request for Bids (RFB) as specified in the World Bank's "Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers, Seventh Edition, September 2025 (“the Regulations”), and is open to all eligible Bidders as defined in the Procurement Regulations. 4. Bids will be evaluated in accordance with the evaluation process set out in the bidding document. The following weightings shall apply for Rated Criteria (including technical and non-price factors): 60% , and for Bid cost: 40% . 5. Interested eligible Bidders may obtain further information from the Project Manager, Project Implementation Unit (PIU), Urban Resilience Project (URP), Ministry of Public Works, Infrastructure and Utilities (MPWIU) (email: jegasothy1974@gmail.com), and inspect the bidding document during office hours (0900 to 1700 hours, Majuro Local Time) at the address given below. 6. The bidding document in English may be obtained by interested eligible Bidders upon the submission of a written application to the address below. The document will be provided free of charge by email. 7. A Pre-Bid Conference will be held on November 5, 2026, at 4:00 PM (Majuro time) at the Ministry of Public Works, Infrastructure and Utilities (MPWIU) Conference Room, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands. Interested bidders may attend in person or virtually. We will provide a Zoom meeting link to participants who wish to attend remotely. 8. Bids must be delivered to the address specified below on or before November 26, 2026, no later than 2:00 PM (RMI Time). If submitted electronically , the Technical Part and Financial Part shall be submitted as separate password-protected files. The password for the Technical Part shall be provided at the online opening of the Technical Part; the password for the Financial Part shall be kept securely by the Bidder and provided at the online opening of the Financial Part. If the password for the Financial Part does not work at the opening, the Bid will be considered non-responsive. It is the Bidder's responsibility to ensure the passwords are correct and secure. If hand-delivered : the outer Bid envelopes marked "ORIGINAL BID", and the inner envelopes marked "TECHNICAL PART" will be publicly opened in the presence of the Bidders' designated representatives and anyone who chooses to attend, at the address below on [insert location, time and date]. All envelopes or files marked "FINANCIAL PART" shall remain unopened and will be held in safe custody of the Employer until the second public Bid opening. Late Bids will be rejected. 9. All Bids must be accompanied by a Bid-Securing Declaration in the prescribed form (Section IV, Bidding Forms — Form of Bid-Securing Declaration) 10. Attention is drawn to the Procurement Regulations requiring the Borrower to disclose information on the successful bidder’s beneficial ownership, as part of the Contract Award Notice, using the Beneficial Ownership Disclosure Form as included in the bidding document. 11. The address(es) referred to above is (are):      Project Manager,     Project Implementation Unit (PIU), Urban Resilience Project (URP)     Ministry of Public Works, Infrastructure and Utilities (MPWIU), Delap, Majuro, Republic of          the Marshall Islands 96960     Telephone: +692 625-8931     Electronic mail address: jegasothy1974@gmail. com , with copy to: walter.myazoe@rmigov.mh      and andrike.sonyia@gmail.com

Request for Bids

Small Works

(Two-Envelope Bidding Process)

Employer: Ministry of Public Works, Infrastructure and Utilities

Project: Urban Resilience Project

Contract title: MAJURO RESILIENT PUBLIC SPACE IMPROVEMENT

Phase 1: Lot 1(Alele museum site) and Lot 2 (Katoj park site)

Country: Marshall Islands

Grant No.: Grant No.: E6610-MH

RFB No.: MH-MWIU-571264-CW-RFB

Issued on: October 22, 2026

1. The Ministry of Public Works, Infrastructure and Utilities (MPWIU), Republic of the Marshall Islands, represented by the Project Implementation Unit (PIU) (Employer), has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Urban Resilience Project – Component 3, and intends to apply part of the proceeds toward payments under the contracts for the Majuro Resilient Public Space Improvement.

2. The Ministry of Public Works, Infrastructure and Utilities (MPWIU) now invites sealed Bids from eligible Bidders for the development of Alele Museum Site and Katoj Park Site, Majuro Atoll, divided into two (2) Lots:

        Lot 1 (Alele Museum Site) – Phase 1,

        Lot 2 (Katoj Park Site) – Phase 1,

to enhance public open space, recreational space, cultural heritage value, and climate resilience at Majuro's key civic, cultural, and recreational sites. Bidders may bid for one or both Lots, as further defined in this Bidding Document. No discount for the award of a combination of Lots shall apply; each Lot's Bid Price shall be evaluated individually. Full details of the scope for each Lot are set out in Section II (Bid Data Sheet) and Section VII (Works' Requirements) of this Bidding Document. As a summary, the estimated construction period for Lot 1 is 12 months and Lot 2 is 18 months, with a Defects Liability Period of 12 months for each Lot.

3. Bidding will be conducted through international competitive procurement using Request for Bids (RFB) as specified in the World Bank's "Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers, Seventh Edition, September 2025 (“the Regulations”), and is open to all eligible Bidders as defined in the Procurement Regulations.

4. Bids will be evaluated in accordance with the evaluation process set out in the bidding document. The following weightings shall apply for Rated Criteria (including technical and non-price factors): 60%, and for Bid cost: 40%.

5. Interested eligible Bidders may obtain further information from the Project Manager, Project Implementation Unit (PIU), Urban Resilience Project (URP), Ministry of Public Works, Infrastructure and Utilities (MPWIU) (email: jegasothy1974@gmail.com), and inspect the bidding document during office hours (0900 to 1700 hours, Majuro Local Time) at the address given below.

6. The bidding document in English may be obtained by interested eligible Bidders upon the submission of a written application to the address below. The document will be provided free of charge by email.

7. A Pre-Bid Conference will be held on November 5, 2026, at 4:00 PM (Majuro time) at the Ministry of Public Works, Infrastructure and Utilities (MPWIU) Conference Room, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands. Interested bidders may attend in person or virtually. We will provide a Zoom meeting link to participants who wish to attend remotely.

8. Bids must be delivered to the address specified below on or before November 26, 2026, no later than 2:00 PM (RMI Time).

  • If submitted electronically, the Technical Part and Financial Part shall be submitted as separate password-protected files. The password for the Technical Part shall be provided at the online opening of the Technical Part; the password for the Financial Part shall be kept securely by the Bidder and provided at the online opening of the Financial Part. If the password for the Financial Part does not work at the opening, the Bid will be considered non-responsive. It is the Bidder's responsibility to ensure the passwords are correct and secure.
  • If hand-delivered: the outer Bid envelopes marked "ORIGINAL BID", and the inner envelopes marked "TECHNICAL PART" will be publicly opened in the presence of the Bidders' designated representatives and anyone who chooses to attend, at the address below on [insert location, time and date]. All envelopes or files marked "FINANCIAL PART" shall remain unopened and will be held in safe custody of the Employer until the second public Bid opening.

Late Bids will be rejected.

9. All Bids must be accompanied by a Bid-Securing Declaration in the prescribed form (Section IV, Bidding Forms — Form of Bid-Securing Declaration)

10. Attention is drawn to the Procurement Regulations requiring the Borrower to disclose information on the successful bidder’s beneficial ownership, as part of the Contract Award Notice, using the Beneficial Ownership Disclosure Form as included in the bidding document.

11. The address(es) referred to above is (are):

     Project Manager,

    Project Implementation Unit (PIU), Urban Resilience Project (URP)

    Ministry of Public Works, Infrastructure and Utilities (MPWIU), Delap, Majuro, Republic of          the Marshall Islands 96960

    Telephone: +692 625-8931

    Electronic mail address: jegasothy1974@gmail.com , with copy to: walter.myazoe@rmigov.mh      and andrike.sonyia@gmail.com
